lyrics:
[Spoken Word]

Epistemic Sabotage: Let AI read your comic – not draw it!

Welcome to Uncle FrizzleBob's Kayfa-Bizarro Comic Card Karaoke!
Bring a comic.
Leave the ego.

Uncle FrizzleBob's Meta-Message, use AI as your critic and teacher.
Revolution won't be generated.

Erlangen, pitchforks up! The Two-Headed Podium Monster, Friend or Fee; loudest arguments miss point.

The Monocled Robo-Owl, AI receptive tool reads image instead of stealing style

The Paint-Vomiting Toad, copies your voice, forgets what you were trying to say.

Locked out: The Brick Wall Turtle, inaccessible; comics built fortresses, not doors.

The Boombox Bat, Silent panels into multi-layered audio play; story escapes page.

The Tactile Mole, Visual nuance into touchable geography; felt before understood.

Un-fluff it: The Simple-Speak Sloth distills webs into Leichte Sprache. Complexity, ego trip.

The Polyglot Parrot, translation at lightning speed; skeleton, cannot breathe life.

The Rhythm Rhino, soul of joke rarely survives literal border crossing.

It read my comic. The Scar-Shifting Chameleon, timeline glitches; magically healing wound.

The Dyslexic Woodpecker, hunts forgotten quotation marks across 200 pages.

The Retro-Tram Walrus, accuracy for every signpost; past, unforgiving critic.

The Caffeinated Bloodhound, fastest start of hunt, rarely final destination.

The Lying Fox-Bot, lies to save itself from saying I don't know.

The Dust-Bunny Librarian, machine accelerates search, only archive confirms truth.

The Begging Bear, masterpiece easier than asking strangers to pay.

Form 7b: The Bureaucracy Beaver, German funding jungle worships format.

The Boxing Kangaroo-Bot, know your story once forced to defend it.

It looks: The Staring Lemur, Architecture of masterpieces; machine look with you, not draw.

The Indexing Arachnid, Twenty years into searchable index; archive or trash can.

The Umbrella Frog, Rain and night scenes located; unspectacular utility as grace.

The Monolithic Data-Whale, tool shifts power to you or away from you.

The Seesaw Elephant, refusing tools hands future to corporations.

My comic first. The Wide-Eyed Fawn, reads comic stripped of author's defensive explanations.

The Nerd-Herd Sheep, you can't bluff genre fan.

The Stumbling Goat, eye confused, brain stops caring about heart.

The Mood-Ring Octopus, perfect page worthless if emotional temperature flat.

Now gently: The Spectacled Badger, constructive feedback? What works before what's broken.

The Ticking Tortoise, Narrative rhythm audited; time physical distance in ink.

The Drafting-Table Beaver, Compositional flow; reader's eye bullied by layout.

The Interrogator Toad, small questions won't save broken foundation.

Salty mode: The Salt-Shaker Vulture, kindness to artist, cruelty to art.

Ow. The Yawning Hippo, Predictable story part; greatest sin is being convenient.

Ow, ow. The Sadistic Pelican, Deep idea merely pretending; hollow echo deafens reader.

Medic! The St. Bernard of Rescue, destruction without path to salvation is just vandalism.

Dear future me: The Silver-Haired Time-Fox, time, only critic that cannot be argued with.

The Puffed-Up Peacock, Technical triumphs endure; worst work monument to skill.

The Facepalming Ostrich, growth measured by severity of future embarrassment.

The Sprouting Acorn-Pig, next great era hiding as mistake in current draft.

The Perspiring Penguin, brilliance evaporates if you cannot speak its name.

The Ascending Giraffe, more than one breath, they have stopped listening.

The Fishing Cat, Hook differentiates work; good irrelevant, distinct survival.

The Jabba-Toad Publisher, publishing, transaction with swamp.

Lights down. The Sand-Burying Ostrich, pencil strokes while world burns.

The Missile-Riding Pigeon, algorithm that helps you draw, cousin of strike algorithm.

The Lantern Anglerfish, billionaires' endgame? Marketing, not liberation.

The Gavel Vulture, law at speed of bureaucracy, machine at speed of theft.

Lights up: The Giant Ear-Bat, AI receptive, analytical entity; machine listens or replaces.

The Steering-Wheel Raccoon, means of utilization. Hotwire master's car.

Remember my comic? The Probe-Stage Chameleon, crash-test dummy for your ego.

The Multi-Armed Sloth, automates grunt work; resurrects artist.

The Panting Cheetah, action easy to draw; exhaustion requires genius.

The Gap-Toothed Gator, White space between boxes; magic in blood between boxes.

The Elephant's Post-it, 200 pages so they remember one panel forever.

Still Form 7b? The Machete-Wielding Monkey, German funding labyrinth; administrative violence.

Still yours: The Glowing Firefly, Human spark, authorial intent; machine cannot decide home.

The Sentient Eraser, judgment over what stays and what is destroyed; wisdom to erase.

The Screaming Possum, easier to edit garbage than birth perfection.

Pitchforks down: Uncle FrizzleBob's Megaphone, pick up pencils, hotwire algorithm.

My comic? Still mine.
Stay Fluffy!
